name: MonarchOtpPinInput
title: OTPPinInput
wrapsNative: TextField or SecureField with .textContentType(.oneTimeCode), drawn as cells
summary: A one-time code or PIN drawn as one cell per character, over a single standard text field with the one-time-code content type.
whenToUse: For a verification code sent by message or email, or a short PIN.
whenNotToUse: For a password use MonarchPasswordInput. For free text use MonarchTextField.
api: init(_ label: String, text: Binding<String>, length: Int = 6, helper: String? = nil, error: String? = nil, mode: MonarchOtpPinInputMode = .numeric, size: MonarchOtpPinInputSize = .md, isMasked: Bool = false, lengthHint: String? = nil, groupSize: Int? = nil, onComplete: (@MainActor (String) -> Void)? = nil)

options.name: text
options.description: The code. It receives only cleaned text: digits, or digits and A to Z in upper case, never longer than length.

options.name: length
options.description: The number of characters. Values under 1 count as 1.

options.name: error
options.description: Error message; replaces the helper while present.

options.name: mode
options.description: numeric accepts digits and opens the number pad; alphanumeric accepts A to Z and digits.

options.name: size
options.description: md cells are 44 by 44 points, lg cells 52 by 48.

options.name: isMasked
options.description: Shows dots instead of the characters and uses a SecureField.

options.name: groupSize
options.description: Draws a wider gap after every this many cells. Visual only.

options.name: onComplete
options.description: Runs each time the code reaches length characters.

states.name: empty
states.description: Empty cells with the input border.

states.name: focused
states.description: The cell that takes the next character has the theme's focus ring and, while empty, a caret.

states.name: filled
states.description: Each typed character is shown in its cell, or as a dot when masked.

states.name: error
states.description: Danger border on every cell, and an icon and message under the cells.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Subtle background and the disabled text colour, set with disabled(_:).

appearance: Surface-coloured cells with an input border and 8-point corners. The active cell has the theme's focus ring, which is wider and in the text colour in the high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The same single-field design as the web, where one input sits under drawn slots. iOS uses the system one-time-code content type for autofill from Messages instead of autocomplete="one-time-code". The caret does not blink. The web's hover state and readOnly have no counterpart here.
accessibility: One VoiceOver element, the real text field: label, then the code as its value (hidden by the system when masked).
The hint is the code length, then the error (spoken as "Error: …") or else the helper text.
A new error message is announced when it appears.
The error is shown with an icon and text, not colour alone.
Cells are at least 44 points high and the whole row focuses the field.
The cells keep left-to-right order in right-to-left layouts, because a code is read left to right.
Cells and characters scale with Dynamic Type; cells shrink in width to fit the available width.
edgeCases: Digits from any script (Arabic-Indic, full-width) are stored as ASCII digits.
A binding set from outside to text that is not clean is shown cleaned; the binding is rewritten only on the next edit.
onComplete also runs when an edit replaces one complete code with another.
A masked input uses SecureField, which the system may clear when editing starts again.
With many cells at the largest text sizes, characters scale down to half size before they clip.

examples.title: Verify a code
A masked four-digit PIN
examples.code: MonarchOtpPinInput("PIN", text: $pin, length: 4, size: .lg, isMasked: true)

examples.title: Grouped, with an error
examples.code:
MonarchOtpPinInput(
    "Code",
    text: $code,
    error: "That code has expired.",
    groupSize: 3
)
